capabilities.label: admin API
capabilities._comment_methods: POST is not a write here: /__admin/requests/find is a search. Method is a poor proxy for danger on this API, so the deny list below carries the weight.
capabilities._comment_deny: The instance is shared across developers and stages. These endpoints hit everyone: reset clears the whole request journal, mappings/reset drops every stub, shutdown stops the server. Scoped deletes (requests/remove with a RequestPattern) stay available. Drop any of these if you decide you want them.
